jobs.title: Forward Deployed Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Adelphi
Adelphi's Vision is to build the biggest AI Deployment company for National Security, which requires talent that is extremely good at problem solving, gets excited about National Security challenges, and thrives in software factories. We're executing a Mission that (1) Identifies the core bottlenecks in Warfighting, Intelligence and the Enterprise, (2) Assigns top talent with backgrounds in systems and machine learning engineering, and (3) Finds repeatability in solution development to target similar offices across the DoW/IC. The business has 10x'd in under two years and has built trust with the senior most leaders at the Department of War and Intelligence Community.

About the Role

The Forward Deployed Senior Machine Learning Engineer position requires a mix of software development, LLM Ops, and DevSecOps practices, resulting in an exciting, fast-paced engineering role. This role requires the ability to provide solutions for the full LLM stack, from the OS, storage, and network up to the API and transport layer. Experience in the defense or intelligence fields is required. You will own end-to-end delivery of agentic, full-stack systems built on top of frontier models, from first prototype to stable production, embedded alongside our defense and intelligence customers.

Location

DC/McLean, with 2-3 days per week in office.

Compensation

Competitive pay within the 75th-90th percentile with equity.

Clearance Requirement

An active U.S. Government clearance is required.

Is this you?

We are an AI-native engineering team. We expect every engineer to leverage LLMs and AI tooling as a core part of how they design, build, ship, and operate agentic systems that turn frontier-model capability into mission outcomes.

  • You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) daily and instinctively.

  • You prompt-engineer through complex architecture and debug sessions, leverage LLMs across the full development lifecycle, maintain a clear-eyed view of AI limitations in high-security contexts, and stay current with emerging models and tooling.

  • Hands-on with modern agent frameworks and SDKs (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, AutoGen, or similar) and agent evaluation / observability tooling.

  • Familiarity with MCP or similar LLM integration frameworks.

  • You have a clear-eyed view of AI limitations. You know when to trust AI-generated output and when to verify.

Expectations

  • Own end-to-end delivery of agentic, full-stack systems from first prototype to stable production, embedded alongside defense and intelligence customers.

  • Build and deploy ML services leveraging LLMs, embeddings, RAG, and agent orchestration into production environments, including classified and air-gapped ones.

  • Work directly with customers to scope problems, sequence delivery, and ship novel AI applications under real-world constraints.

  • Codify repeatable patterns into reusable tools and building blocks that help the team ship faster.

Bonus Points

  • Proficiency in infrastructure management (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).

  • Expertise in encryption, authentication, Linux systems administration, DevOps, or SRE.

  • Production experience launching agentic services and forward-deployed AI applications that drive operational value at the customer site.

  • Experience as a forward-deployed engineer or tech-led delivery role, embedded with mission customers, scoping problems, sequencing delivery, and shipping novel agentic applications under tight constraints

  • Experience with federated or privacy-preserving data architectures (such as differential privacy and secure enclaves).

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Adelphi
Adelphi's Vision is to build the biggest AI Deployment company for National Security, which requires talent that is extremely good at problem solving, gets excited about National Security challenges, and thrives in software factories. We're executing a Mission that (1) Identifies the core bottlenecks in Warfighting, Intelligence and the Enterprise, (2) Assigns top talent with backgrounds in systems and machine learning engineering, and (3) Finds repeatability in solution development to target similar offices across the DoW/IC. The business has 10x'd in under two years and has built trust with the senior most leaders at the Department of War and Intelligence Community.

About the Role

As Adelphi's ISSM, you will own the security program for Adelphi. On the company side, that means running our compliance program, including CMMC Level 2, and serving as the primary interface to the Department of War Authorizing Official, assessors, and our customer program office. On the ATO side, this role is deliberately more hands-on than a traditional ISSM: for the next 6 to 12 months you will operate as an ISSO and ISSE blend, owning the authorization package and eMASS artifacts and personally verifying that the system meets each control, not just that the paperwork says it does. You will drive Adelphi's work through Department of War authorization on the IL2 (NIPR) path and onto a defensible IL5 trajectory, operating on a continuous-ATO cadence that matches our weekly sprint pace. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with a small, high-velocity engineering team that is building AI agents in uncharted territory, and you will be the clear voice that tells them what is and is not acceptable in the environment, including when the answer is no.

Location

DC/McLean, with 2-3 days per week in office.

Clearance Requirement

Active Top Secret/SCI

Is this you?

  • Security Program Ownership: You've owned a government security program end-to-end, from initial authorization through continuous monitoring, and know how to keep it moving inside a fast-paced engineering team without becoming a bottleneck. You have personally led at least one DoD or IC system through the NIST RMF authorization process to an ATO and sustained it through continuous monitoring, and you have done the ISSO-level work yourself: building the package, managing POA&Ms, running ConMon, and uploading and defending artifacts in eMASS. Prior ISSM, ISSO or ISSE experience on a DoD or IC contract is required; experience as a Prime contractor is strongly preferred.

  • Experience: 8+ years in cybersecurity, information assurance, or security engineering, with a substantial portion directly supporting DoD or IC systems. You have a track record of delivering this work reliably and under scrutiny.

  • Security Architecture & Technical Depth: You are more technical than the typical ISSM. You can read an architecture, trace a data flow, and verify for yourself whether a control is actually implemented across identity, authorization, cryptography, logging and audit. Backgrounds in penetration testing, security engineering, systems engineering or DevSecOps that later moved into ISSM or ISSO work are a strong fit. You've worked in environments where the security boundaries between systems matter, and you know how to design for them deliberately. Experience at IL5 or IL6, and with FedRAMP inheritance modeling and CSP shared-responsibility mapping, is a plus.

  • Agentic AI & Emerging Tech: You're familiar with how AI agents interact with data and tools, and you've thought seriously about what securing those interactions looks like, even if the specific stack is new to you. Our engineers will bring plenty of ideas for how to use AI, including for compliance automation itself; we need you to be the person who evaluates those ideas against the authorization boundary and says no when something is too risky, with a clear explanation of why. Familiarity with Palantir Foundry, O365/SharePoint, or Databricks in classified or IL5 environments is a bonus.

  • Security Operations & Incident Response: You've run security operations and led incident response in complex environments. You write clear, structured findings for both technical and executive audiences.

  • Stakeholder Management: You've been the primary security interface to government customers, assessors, and internal engineering leadership, and you know how to manage all of them at once.

  • Certifications: A current DoD 8140 / 8570 IAM-qualifying certification is required at hire. CISSP or CISM (IAM Level III) strongly preferred; CASP+ accepted. Security+ is required for work in Department of War production environments. You must be able to maintain certification currency throughout the role.

  • Bonus points if you have prior experience standing up a security program at a startup or small company

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Adelphi
Adelphi's Vision is to build the biggest AI Deployment company for National Security, which requires talent that is extremely good at problem solving, gets excited about National Security challenges, and thrives in software factories. We're executing a Mission that (1) Identifies the core bottlenecks in Warfighting, Intelligence and the Enterprise, (2) Assigns top talent with backgrounds in systems and machine learning engineering, and (3) Finds repeatability in solution development to target similar offices across the DoW/IC. The business has 10x'd in under two years and has built trust with the senior most leaders at the Department of War and Intelligence Community.

About the Role

We're looking for a Recruiter to own hiring end to end, working directly with our Head of Talent. Adelphi is a small, fast-moving startup building AI-native software for defense and national security customers, and we are growing across engineering and the business. You'll run full-cycle recruiting for technical and non-technical roles, from the first sourcing message to a signed offer. This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one, and you'll have a hand in building how we hire as the company grows.

Location

DC/McLean, with 2-3 days per week in office.

Expectations

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for technical roles (forward deployed engineers, software engineers, ML engineers) and non-technical roles across the business

  • Source passive candidates through outbound outreach, referrals and your own network, and build pipelines for the roles we hire for on a rolling basis

  • Run intro calls that tell the Adelphi story well and give candidates a clear picture of the role and the interview process

  • Partner with hiring managers on intake, calibration, interview loops and timely feedback

  • Keep our ATS (Ashby) accurate and current so pipeline, stage and scheduling data is something we can rely on

  • Manage scheduling and candidate communication so every candidate has a great experience, whatever the outcome

  • Close candidates: run the offer process with the Head of Talent and keep candidates warm through to their start date

  • Help build the recruiting function: process, templates, employer brand and our referral program

Is this you?

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in-house at a startup or fast-growing company

  • A track record hiring software, ML engineers & Forward Deployed Engineers, plus experience with non-technical roles across a business

  • Strong sourcing skills and real comfort with cold outreach to passive candidates

  • The ability to sell a role, read a candidate and close an offer

  • High ownership. You run your reqs end to end and don't wait to be asked.

  • Clear, warm written communication and attention to detail in everything candidate-facing

  • Experience hiring for cleared roles or in defense tech is a plus
